options.name: comment
options.description: Add a comment to the rule. Requires UFW version >=0.35.

options.name: default
options.description: Change the default policy for incoming or outgoing traffic.

options.name: delete
options.description: Delete rule. If O(delete=true) and a value is provided for O(insert), then O(insert) is ignored.

options.name: direction
options.description: Select direction for a rule or default policy command. Mutually exclusive with O(interface_in) and O(interface_out).

options.name: from_ip
options.description: Source IP address.

options.name: from_port
options.description: Source port.

options.name: insert
options.description: Insert the corresponding rule as rule number NUM. Note that ufw numbers rules starting with 1. If O(delete=true) and a value is provided for O(insert), then O(insert) is ignored.

options.name: insert_relative_to
options.description: Allows to interpret the index in O(insert) relative to a position. V(zero) interprets the rule number as an absolute index (that is, 1 is the first rule). V(first-ipv4) interprets the rule number relative to the index of the first IPv4 rule, or relative to the position where the first IPv4 rule would be if there is currently none. V(last-ipv4) interprets the rule number relative to the index of the last IPv4 rule, or relative to the position where the last IPv4 rule would be if there is currentl

options.name: interface
options.description: Specify interface for the rule. The direction (in or out) used for the interface depends on the value of O(direction). See O(interface_in) and O(interface_out) for routed rules that needs to supply both an input and output interface. Mutually exclusive with O(interface_in) and O(interface_out).

options.name: interface_in
options.description: Specify input interface for the rule. This is mutually exclusive with O(direction) and O(interface). However, it is compatible with O(interface_out) for routed rules.

options.name: interface_out
options.description: Specify output interface for the rule. This is mutually exclusive with O(direction) and O(interface). However, it is compatible with O(interface_in) for routed rules.

options.name: log
options.description: Log new connections matched to this rule.

options.name: logging
options.description: Toggles logging. Logged packets use the LOG_KERN syslog facility.

options.name: name
options.description: Use profile located in C(/etc/ufw/applications.d).

options.name: proto
options.description: TCP/IP protocol. The value V(vrrp) is supported since community.general 10.3.0.

options.name: route
options.description: Apply the rule to routed/forwarded packets.

options.name: rule
options.description: Add firewall rule.

options.name: state
options.description: V(enabled) reloads firewall and enables firewall on boot. V(disabled) unloads firewall and disables firewall on boot. V(reloaded) reloads firewall. V(reset) disables and resets firewall to installation defaults.

options.name: to_ip
options.description: Destination IP address.

options.name: to_port
options.description: Destination port.
